scripts.build: npm run build -w @puc/core && npm run build -w @puc/aftermath && npm run build -w @puc/control && npm run build -w @puc/web
scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -n control,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @puc/control" "npm run dev -w @puc/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @puc/core && npm run test -w @puc/aftermath && npm run test -w @puc/control && npm run test -w @puc/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/aftermath apps/control --pretty false && npm run typecheck -w @puc/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
